limits: Class-labeled recordings can include background sound; not pure physical-source truth.
Repetition of three source files, no independent-scene confidence interval.
Boundary windows have deliberately different event content; compare per-boundary matched transient examples, do not infer causal join artifacts from pooled ratios.
Class attribution via evaluator-only least-squares regression is diagnostic; it does not establish physical identity.
No natural multitrack or subjective listening-quality claim.
Source-reference report is computed only after actual inference/export completed.
